The main takeaway from our work is that
observational analyses should be conducted in a way that is faithful to the target randomized trial, which can be achieved by emulating the target trial.
the use of real-world data in observational studies should be complemented with the explicit emulation of a randomized trial.
observational analyses should not be used as a replacement for randomized trials, but they can complement randomized evidence when the latter is not available or is inconclusive.
